A current local Compustat vintage is used; coverage and historical field semantics cannot be assumed identical to the authors' data vintage.

Currency-mismatched constructions are marked unavailable under an exact same-CURCD rule. The paper does not describe currency conversion; the local provider guide documents CURRTR (A228) as a USD conversion rate, but the conversion procedure is unspecified.
